decision: Retain all 490 provisional groups; no additional manual merges or removals. No clear additional claim-variant link was identified in the inspected candidate pairs.

examples.reason: Opposing versions of the OCT4/SOX2/GATA3 reprogramming claim; already grouped.
Eight distinct or opposing pyridostatin claims share a known relevant document; a conservative group, not eight identical claims.
Shared lupus topic, but different relationships: cardiovascular risk versus basophil disease mechanism; not clear paraphrases from these texts.
Exact normalized duplicate text; q89 positives are 22406695 and 7521113, q90 has 22406695. Preserve original qrels.

limitations: Only candidate/nearest-neighbor text and large groups were inspected; not every possible semantic pair.
Character n-gram similarity can miss paraphrases and is insensitive to some word-order differences.
Nearest-neighbor pairs below 0.75 may still be related; no proof of zero leakage.
Shared known positives and source contexts can merge distinct claims.
The exclusion map is a prerequisite for sampling, not proof that future mined negatives are all irrelevant.
review_type: AI-assisted inspection of uploaded training-only text; not independent human or domain-expert adjudication

split_policy.selection: first ceil(groups/5) groups ordered by SHA256 of compact JSON [seed, sorted query IDs]
